templates.name: Silver_Template_01.png
templates.prompt: Edit target: attached original Silver game card. Create a completely blank reusable card template matching THIS EXACT palette. Remove ALL typography including 25%, all bottom small print, all illustrations and black decorative ornaments/ink flourishes. Keep ONLY opaque pale warm beige parchment center and a narrow distressed matte light neutral silver-grey, exactly the existing silver-grey border. Match reference parchment color, texture brightness and border pigment very closely; no new grading, no stronger vignette, no new hues. Full flat front-facing rectangular card, rounded worn corners, tightly fitted original silhouette, no perspective or shadow. Transparent alpha ONLY outside card. Exact requested dimensions 640 x 984 pixels, portrait. Border about same width as reference. Blank center must have no ghost letters, no symbols or recognizable images. Variant 1: distinctive fine scattered irregular chips, worn top-left and bottom-right corners, many small gently frayed spots, moderate natural abrasion. No text, watermark, logos, pictures or ornaments. Output ONE PNG.
